query: How do I update the app? I cannot find where to do it.
draft:
Hello,

We can help with updating the app. To update, update to the latest app version, then restart your phone. If the app still crashes, clear the app cache in your phone settings and sign in again. If it keeps crashing after that, reinstall the app. Your orders and account data are stored online and are not lost. Additional tips: close other apps, ensure at least 500 MB of free storage, and try switching between Wi‑Fi and mobile data.

NovaGear Support
facts:
- Update to the latest app version.
- Restart your phone.
- If the app still crashes, clear the app cache in your phone settings and sign in again.
- If it keeps crashing after that, reinstall the app.
- Your orders and account data are stored online and are not lost.
- Additional tips: close other apps, make sure you have at least 500 MB of free storage, and switching between Wi-Fi and mobile data can also help.

query: I typed the wrong password too many times and now I am locked out.
draft:
Hello,

If you see "Account locked," wait 15 minutes and try again—the lock is removed automatically after too many wrong attempts. To regain access, open the login screen and tap Forgot password, enter your account email, and we will send a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes. If the email does not arrive within 5 minutes, check your spam folder, then request a new link.

NovaGear Support
facts:
- If you see "Account locked", wait 15 minutes and try again; the lock is removed automatically after too many wrong attempts.
- Reset password steps: Open the login screen and tap Forgot password. Enter your account email and we send a reset link that is valid for 30 minutes.
- If the email does not arrive within 5 minutes, check your spam folder, then request a new link.
